bill.title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of June 6, 2025, as "National Gun Violence Awareness Day" and June 2025 as "National Gun Violence Awareness Month".
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (text: CR S3172-3173)
bill.officialSummary: This resolution supports the designation of National Gun Violence Awareness Month and the designation of National Gun Violence Awareness Day.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
